title: How do you feel? Measuring User-Perceived Value for Rejecting Machine Decisions in Hate Speech Detection
benchmark_measurement: The paper did not measure any aspect of faith or religion. The study focused on a general methodology for measuring user-perceived value of machine decisions in hate speech detection, without specifying the type of hate speech.
findings: This paper does not analyze or report findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the research.
